descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S07 Same-day re-processing, both modes: unchanged text does not bring back a deleted extracted row or task; dictating it again does

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A deleted medication row, task or Important Point does not reappear on the next day's processing (or any later processing) unless the physician dictates it again. (UAT TC-24; TFA-94699 AC 5; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician. Hospital patient with one kept row 'Apixaban 5 mg PO BID' and one kept task; Nursing Home resident with one kept row 'Donepezil 10 mg PO nightly' and one kept task

When Hospital: type a pre-round text that names a drug and a task, Save Note, delete the extracted row and task, press Save Note again without changing the text, then replace the text with a new sentence that dictates both again and Save Note. Nursing Home: the same with the visit text and Save & Extract.

Then After the unchanged re-processing the deleted row and task are not back (held: Q3). After the new dictation they are back, because the physician dictated them again. Kept rows and tasks stay throughout.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94699 AC 5 ('never comes back unless re-dictated'). cp1, cp2, cp7 and cp8 are preconditions: if the extraction did not create the row and the task, the run is Invalid. Unchanged re-processing (cp3, cp4, cp9, cp10): must not contain the deleted row or task, with the kept row or task as positive control; …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
